item: NBC News projects Democrats win control of the U.S. Senate, in addition to the House. CNBC also reports Democrats have flipped the Senate.
source: NBC News live blog and Senate results page; CNBC

item: AP calls Ohio's special Senate election for Democrat Sherrod Brown over Republican Sen. Jon Husted (Brown 48.6%, Husted 46.5% at the call); NBC News also projects Brown.
source: AP via Local 12 (WKRC); NBC News results page

item: AP calls Iowa's governor race for Democrat Rob Sand over Republican Zach Lahn (Sand 57.7%, Lahn 42.3%, 79% counted); CBS News and DDHQ also project Sand.
source: AP via Washington Examiner; CBS News; DDHQ

item: AP calls Kansas's Senate race for Democrat Adam Hamilton over Republican Sen. Roger Marshall, joining DDHQ; shown as won here. AP also calls Arkansas's Senate race for Republican Sen. Tom Cotton, joining Fox News.
source: AP via KSHB and KATV; DDHQ; Fox News

item: CBS News and DDHQ project Democratic Gov. Katie Hobbs wins Arizona's governor race over Republican Andy Biggs; shown as won here.
source: CBS News and DDHQ via KTAR, azfamily

item: DDHQ projects Democrat Josh Turek wins Iowa's Senate race over Republican Ashley Hinson; awaiting a second call.
source: DDHQ via The Hill

item: NBC News projects Democrat Gina Hinojosa wins Texas's governor race over Gov. Greg Abbott (57% to 41.7% with 67% counted as of 11:17 PM); awaiting a second call. An ABC7 Amarillo headline reports Abbott conceded.
source: NBC News results page; Washington Examiner; ABC7 Amarillo

item: Concessions (not race calls): in Maine's governor race, Republican Bobby Charles and independent Rick Bennett conceded to Democrat Hannah Pingree; in South Carolina, Democrat Jermaine Johnson conceded to Republican Alan Wilson.
source: Portland Press Herald; SC Daily Gazette

item: AP calls California's governor race for Democrat Xavier Becerra; NBC News also projects him. Oregon: Gov. Tina Kotek leads 55.6% to 41.8% in early returns. Montana Senate: Republican Kurt Alme leads with independent Seth Bodnar second and Democrat Alani Bankhead third, 28% in. Nevada has not reported votes yet.
source: AP via KTLA; NBC News results (AP data)

item: AP calls Ohio's governor race for Democrat Amy Acton over Republican Vivek Ramaswamy (Acton 50.7%, Ramaswamy 46%, 85% counted).
source: AP via Washington Examiner

item: NBC News and Fox News project Democrat James Talarico wins Texas's Senate race over Republican Ken Paxton, joining DDHQ; shown as won here (Fox count: Talarico 59.21%, Paxton 39.21%, 67% in).
source: NBC News results page; Fox News results; DDHQ

item: NBC News's House results page headline reads "Democrats Win Majority", indicating an NBC projection of House control. AP's last retrieved House tally (9:20 PM) was 73 Democratic, 36 Republican seats called.
source: NBC News results page; AP via Yahoo News

item: AP calls Wisconsin's governor race for Democrat David Crowley over Republican Tom Tiffany; NBC News also projects him. Shown as won here.
source: AP via WUWM; NBC News results page

item: AP calls New Mexico's governor race for Democrat Deb Haaland over Republican Gregg Hull.
source: AP via Scripps News, Source NM

item: AP calls Connecticut's governor race for Democratic Gov. Ned Lamont over Republican Ryan Fazio.
source: AP via CKOM

item: AP calls Arkansas's governor race for Republican Gov. Sarah Huckabee Sanders over Democrat Fredrick Love.
source: AP via KATV

item: Decision Desk HQ (with the Bangor Daily News) projects Democrat Hannah Pingree wins Maine's governor race; Republican Bobby Charles and independent Rick Bennett conceded. Awaiting a second call here.
source: Bangor Daily News/DDHQ; Portland Press Herald

item: Fox News calls Oregon's Senate race for Democratic Sen. Jeff Merkley and Arkansas's for Republican Sen. Tom Cotton; both await a second call here.
source: Fox News results

item: Decision Desk HQ projects Democrat Adam Hamilton defeats Republican Sen. Roger Marshall in Kansas's Senate race (Fox count: Hamilton 52.42%, Marshall 44.66%, 86% in). Awaiting a second call here.
source: DDHQ via Bloomberg, The Hill; Fox News results

item: Democrat Amanda Janoo concedes Vermont's governor race to Republican Gov. Phil Scott; AP had not called it at that time. Democrat Jermaine Johnson has conceded South Carolina's governor race to Republican Alan Wilson.
source: VTDigger; SC Daily Gazette

item: New Hampshire's governor race is too close to call per AP: Republican Gov. Kelly Ayotte 50.8%, Democrat Cinde Warmington 47.5%, 59% counted.
source: Boston Globe (citing AP)

item: NBC News (about 9:59 PM), CBS News and Decision Desk HQ project Democrat Annie Andrews defeats Republican Sen. Darline Graham in South Carolina's Senate race, flipping the seat. (Graham, the late Sen. Lindsey Graham's sister, held the seat by appointment; the tracker's listing is corrected.)
source: NBC News via Daily Caller; CBS News; DDHQ via Yahoo News

item: Decision Desk HQ projects Democrat James Talarico defeats Republican Ken Paxton in Texas's Senate race (DDHQ count: Talarico 57.4%, Paxton 41.1%, about 60% counted). Shown as counting here until a second outlet's call is confirmed.
source: DDHQ via Clash Report; The Hill

item: AP projects Democrat Keisha Lance Bottoms wins Georgia's governor race over Republican Rick Jackson, joining NBC News; shown as won here.
source: AP via FOX 5 Atlanta; NBC News

item: AP calls Florida's governor race for Republican Byron Donalds over Democrat David Jolly, joining NBC News; shown as lost here. Local outlets report Jolly has conceded.
source: AP via WINK News; NBC News; Hometown Stations

item: AP and Fox News call Colorado's Senate race for Democratic Sen. John Hickenlooper over Republican Mark Baisley (Hickenlooper 60.98%, Baisley 35.05%, 64% in per Fox News).
source: AP (via Denver Gazette); Fox News

item: AP and Fox News call New Mexico's Senate race for Democratic Sen. Ben Ray Luján over Republican Larry Marker.
source: AP (via WUSA9, GV Wire); Fox News

item: AP calls Wyoming's Senate race for Republican Harriet Hageman over Democrat James Byrd.
source: AP (via GV Wire)

item: AP calls West Virginia's Senate race for Republican Sen. Shelley Moore Capito over Democrat Rachel Fetty Anderson; Fox News also calls it.
source: AP (via WTAP); Fox News

item: AP and Fox News call Oklahoma's Senate race for Republican Kevin Hern over Democrat N'Kiyla Thomas.
source: AP (via WTOP); Fox News
